'''John Arendt''' was named on Decipher's first team of Star Wars '''Player Advocates''', listed under '''Tournament Support'''.<ref name="pc1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020611042314/http://decipher.com/starwars/playerscommittee1.html The Star Wars Players' Committee], decipher.com (Wayback, 11 June 2002; letter dated 25 January 2002)</ref>

This page is a '''fan encyclopedia''' stub.

== Documented PC role and turnover ==

* '''January 2002:''' First Advocates roster &mdash; Tournament Support; one of six Advocates flying to Norfolk to meet Decipher.<ref name="pc1" />
* '''~November 2002:''' swccgpc.com homepage news notes that '''[[Josh Radke|Josh "Red 84" Radke]]''' (Player Relations Advocate) welcomed '''[[Andrew Howard]]''' as Tournament Support Advocate, '''replacing''' former Tournament Advocate John Arendt.<ref name="swccgpc2002home">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021106101746/http://www.swccgpc.com/ The SWCCG Player's Committee], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 6 November 2002)</ref>

Arendt is '''not''' on the December 2002 council.htm Advocate Council roster (Howard appears as Tournament Support Advocate instead).<ref name="council2002">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021209221742/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 9 December 2002)</ref>
